newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to launch $750 mln, 10-year bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to launch $750 mln, 10-year bond issue.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Ministry said it will make a $750 million dollar-denominated bond issue in international markets.
The bonds will have a 10-year maturity, the ministry said.
Lead underwriters of the issue, to be registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), will be Goldman Sachs and Co and Salomon Brothers Inc.

"This issue falls within the budget authorization approved by Congress for the current period and allows us to benefit from the favorable conditions in international financial markets as well as to extend the term of debt placements," a ministry statement said.
The ministry provided no further details on the timing of the issue.
